additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body: Hello, we recently open a ticket to know if Siemens with SCB overwrite the configuration of the customer router and Siemens said no. But we have notice that when a SichargeD make a reboot, the configuration of the customer router was overwriting. SCB sent remote comands when the charger is starting as you can see attached files. Could you please deactivate these comands ? We found another problem with SCB, when we go to "Router configuration", set wan interface to wifi and push on the button "set main wan to wifi", it create another wifi connexion in the RUT240. So each time we push the button we had a new connexion without delete the previous one. Could you fixe this please ?

Happy New Year
I hope all is well with you. Yes, we have identified the cause that is leading to this abnormality and are in touch with R&D to resolve the issue. As we observe the WAN failover, it is getting changed while providing a “Set WAN to Wifi” via SCB. Please be aware that charger reboot will not change the router configuration (WAN fail over) but changing the settings from SCB does the change. I am requesting you to not change the router settings via SCB till we resolve the issue. In order to support you, I can remotely modify the router configurations on the charger. Please feel free to reach out to me in case of any configuration changes to be performed.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
